roles.source: Parquet Lexicon graph exports (vertices keyed by ~id, edges by ~id/~from/~to) for DSA representation and payment plans
roles.target: Pipe-delimited Interprose CSV files: form_1281 rows, payment_plan rows, and payment_plan_schedule rows

transformClassification.evidenceBasis: lexicon-to-interprose@4.0.0 is a version-controlled Spark SQL projection with fixed form constants, a declared DSA election rule, and cents conversion; readiness requires the registered mapping, executed SQL digests, and physical CSV outputs.

fieldNames: form_1281 columns debtID, form_config_id, field_identifier, value with field_identifier DSA_NAME, REPORTED_DATE, DSA_REPRESENTATION, VERIFIED_DATE or DELETE_DATE; payment_plan and payment_plan_schedule columns from interprose.json in declaration order
schemaShape: one form_1281 row per debt and emitted field_identifier, following Claydol form 1281 writes; one payment_plan row per payment plan; one payment_plan_schedule row per installment slot
formats: Parquet graph exports in; pipe-delimited CSV with a header row out
normalizationRules: dollars to integer cents, ISO-8601 UTC timestamps, DSA election per company_identifier by created_at then effective_at
mappingExpressions: lexicon-to-interprose@4.0.0 pinned by mapping.json sha256 1050611b9bb521e00581e2aa6fe71d7625e118e1438fe39e7ec4a1235a77a7d8, S3 VersionId Ko5886TiHSl9ax7iIm6l_5xr0cAfffUd; forward interprose-to-lexicon@1.0.0 mapping.json sha256 b378371147d90f88f2b64d6f4b002bf27417da4e315b7afa88f3ea7ac89a4805, S3 VersionId Gesii87aUnenVBfQKTYFXuiqCwdH95cE
profileInputs: DEV package inputs/lexicon-interprose-v4/20260928-dev-stage-sample_v2/ with stage/ingest-a, stage/ingest-b and lexicon/ manifests
vocabularySelections: existing Lexicon company, debt, payment_plan, payment_plan_installment, and user_account concepts; the only model additions are the four approved optional company_represents_debt properties

invariants.description: src/data/lexicon.json at the pinned candidate equals the pinned Lexicon main except for the lexiconModelPolicy.approvedAdditions properties: removing exactly those properties from the candidate leaves JSON identical to main, so every other concept, property and index definition (including debt is_dsa and dsa_company_name) is unchanged
No label or scoped property from reference/forbidden-concepts.json appears in the candidate or main lexicon.json, in any graph input, or in any executed SQL body

Every v4 input is a Parquet graph export bound to an active Lexicon concept: vertex inputs carry ~id, edge inputs carry ~id, ~from and ~to, and every edge endpoint dataset is itself a declared input of the same output
Each registered output declares exactly the requiredInputs listed in this profile's outputContracts; a missing endpoint dataset is a configuration defect
Every output is registered as csv with options.delimiter '|' and options.header true, and the first physical line of every committed part file equals the declared columns joined by '|'
payment_plan and payment_plan_schedule emit exactly the declared interprose.json columns, in declaration order; no column is populated from a constant or guessed default

Every form_1281 row has form_config_id '1281' and field_identifier DSA_NAME, REPORTED_DATE, DSA_REPRESENTATION, VERIFIED_DATE or DELETE_DATE, with at most one row per (debtID, field_identifier); DSA_REPRESENTATION is only ever 'true'

For each debt, only version 2 company_represents_debt edges with company_type DEBT_SETTLEMENT_AGENCY are considered; they are grouped by company company_identifier (falling back to the company ~id), the latest edge per group is chosen by created_at descending then effective_at descending, and DSA_REPRESENTATION is true exactly when some group's latest edge is ACTIVE, matching the debt is_dsa index definition on the pinned main; DSA_NAME comes from an elected ACTIVE group

payment_plan.payment_total equals round(payment_plan_has_total_amount.total_amount * 100) and payment_plan_schedule.amount equals round(payment_plan_installment.scheduled_amount * 100) as integers; truncation, float text, or a non-null value for a null amount fails

An Interprose sample run through interprose-to-lexicon@1.0.0 and then lexicon-to-interprose@4.0.0 reproduces every declared column of every declared row key after the declared normalization; every difference is either zero or a listed permitted loss
No Persist API, GraphSON ingest, or Neptune load is invoked; graph closure is proven from Transform inputs and outputs only

A request selecting only form_1281 or only payment_plan_schedule succeeds with only that output's required inputs, and requests missing edge-payment-plan-installment-status-changed for payment_plan_schedule or edge-payment-plan-has-total-amount for payment_plan are rejected by resolve-plan before Glue starts
Runtime evidence identifies the executed v4 SQL digests and physical CSV outputs for every selected output; registration-only tests never satisfy this invariant
No form_1281 row carries field_identifier DSA_CLIENT_ID_ or DSA_REPRESENTATION 'false'; Claydol owns the client id and never writes a false representation

Every non-empty payment_plan.payment_method equals the source payment_method; an empty value is permitted only for the documented causes in roundTripStrategy.permittedLosses, and a wrong non-empty value fails
The sample holds at least one debt whose DSA identity is DELETED then ACTIVE (reactivation) and form_1281 represents it exactly when the created_at-first head is ACTIVE
The sample holds at least one company_identifier spanning more than one company vertex (rename) and the election groups it as one identity

The sample holds debts with more than one version 2 DEBT_SETTLEMENT_AGENCY edge, and every such debt matches the independent is_dsa oracle. The two-identity case (one debt, more than one company_identifier) is proven from the read-only PROD graph sample (lexicon-interprose-v4-prod-graph-sample) against PROD is_dsa and dsa_company_name read through the Persist Gremlin API; if a PROD sample shows no such Interprose debts exist, the check narrows to multiple edges per debt with the finding recorded

Owner-accepted substitute (user decision, 2026-09-28): the PROD Interprose payment_plan_schedule extract is skipped, and schedule rows for every attempted slot are not required. attempted-slot-payment-parity is the accepted evidence for attempted slots; this invariant passes when that check passes and every exported slot is backed by a schedule row or a payment attempt

Every exported slot with a payment attempt matches its first attempt on payment_plan_id, amount (cents) and payment_date, and its promise_status and active match the latest attempt outcome (PAID -> KEPT/false, FAILURE -> BROKEN/false, PENDING -> PENDING/true)

Unmerged mapping versions are re-uploaded under the same id@version, so every execution, registry check and comparison is pinned by mapping.json and query SHA-256 plus S3 VersionId recorded in the plan; the version string alone, and evidence from an earlier upload of the same version, never proves the current candidate
form_1281 rows are emitted only for debts whose debt_identifier is all digits (Interprose debt ids); graph-only placeholder debts such as UNMATCHED_SSN_<hash> never appear

For every exported debt in the PROD graph sample, DSA_REPRESENTATION equals PROD debt.is_dsa and DSA_NAME equals PROD debt.dsa_company_name (with CR, LF and pipe replaced by spaces), read-only through the Persist Gremlin API. With several ACTIVE identity heads the mapping reproduces the Gremlin group() java.util.HashMap order; that dependency is a recorded risk, and cases where a simpler order would give the same name do not prove it

payment_plan and payment_plan_schedule are keyed by payment_plan_identifier: a plan whose plan_type change minted a second payment_plan vertex yields exactly one payment_plan row and one schedule row per slot

v4 graph inputs carry DateTime as ISO-8601 UTC strings and Date as yyyy-MM-dd; raw Persist epoch-millis exports are an unsupported input contract, fail in the Glue run rather than in resolve-plan, and are recorded as an input finding, not a mapping failure

form_1281 reproduces Claydol form 1281 writes from the elected identity head: DSA_NAME for every represented debt; REPORTED_DATE (reported_at) and DSA_REPRESENTATION 'true' only when that head's dsa_representation is true; VERIFIED_DATE when that head's verified_at is present; for a debt with no ACTIVE head, DELETE_DATE from the newest head's deleted_at. Differences from Claydol inventory writes that set REPORTED_DATE without a representation are recorded, not silently accepted

On the PROD-reconstruct package, every emitted form_1281 value equals the PROD Stage debt_settlement_agency row it comes from (dsa_name, reported_date, verified_date, delete_date), and the package's Stage rows equal PROD Stage at the pinned snapshot

dsa_representation must come from the Interprose source column once Stage extracts it. The PROD-reconstruct package derives it from Claydol COMPLETED representation records, so REPORTED_DATE and DSA_REPRESENTATION parity is reconstruction evidence only until it is revalidated against real Stage values

v4 runs on graph exports whose company_represents_debt dataset lacks the optional reported_at, verified_at, deleted_at and dsa_representation columns (every edge ingested before the change); absent optional properties behave as typed nulls and the election and DSA_NAME output are unchanged

A forward interprose-to-lexicon change that reads a new Stage column is published to an environment only after that environment's Stage table carries the column, and it does not change an already-published mapping version in place; otherwise every consumer of that version breaks on the next run

repositories.purpose: Lexicon and Interprose language definitions, the existing Interprose-to-Lexicon SQL, and the planned lexicon-to-interprose@4.0.0 mapping
Transform Spark runtime, v2 request contract, and partial-output planning

discoveryProbes.description: Locate the Lexicon branch or PR that registers lexicon-to-interprose@4.0.0 and pin its head SHA
Resolve exact enabled directional mappings, per-output requiredInputs, output options, and query digests
Compare src/data/lexicon.json at the candidate against pinned main by SHA-256 and git diff
Bind the DEV registry mapping.json and Transform deployment to the pinned candidate digests
Read sanitized row counts, header lines, and column-diff aggregates of the CSV outputs

tbd: risk finding, owner Lexicon (debt.dsa_company_name) with kecleon: with several ACTIVE identity heads DSA_NAME reproduces the java.util.HashMap iteration order of the Gremlin group() step, not a business rule; recheck against PROD dsa_company_name after any Neptune or TinkerPop change
REPORTED_DATE and DSA_REPRESENTATION are validated against dsa_representation reconstructed from Claydol records until PROD Stage extracts debt_settlement_agency.dsa_representation

identityRules: Vertex inputs are keyed by ~id and edge inputs by ~id with ~from and ~to, exactly as exported
DSA identity is company company_identifier, falling back to the company ~id, never the physical vertex alone
Never emit debt, company, or user identifiers into validation evidence
endpointRules: Every edge ~from and ~to resolves to a vertex in the same run's declared inputs
Every payment_plan_schedule.payment_plan_id resolves to a payment_plan row of the same run when both outputs are selected
Dangling endpoint count must equal zero

roundTripStrategy.description: Take a sanitized Interprose sample, run the existing Interprose-to-Lexicon SQL (interprose-to-lexicon@1.0.0) restricted to the twelve graph datasets v4 reads, feed that graph into lexicon-to-interprose@4.0.0, and column-diff each CSV output against the same Interprose sample.
normalization: timestamps to ISO-8601 UTC with millisecond precision
empty CSV field equals SQL NULL
permittedLosses: payment_plan_schedule rows that interprose-to-lexicon does not project: past slots with no payment attempt, KEPT and BROKEN slots, and slots of inactive, completed, or deactivated plans
payment_plan_schedule.amount for attempted slots, which the forward SQL takes from the first payment attempt rather than payment_plan_schedule.amount
form_1281 rows for debts whose debt_settlement_agency rows have an empty dsa_name

payment_plan.deactivation_date empty whenever the plan has a COMPLETED event (source complete_date), because the forward SQL emits CANCELLED only when complete_date is null and v4 blanks deactivation_date for completed plans; any other deactivation_date difference fails

payment_plan.payment_method empty when the plan's current installments carry no concrete method (MIXED or PROMISE collapse to OTHER, or no installment), disagree, or are ACH on a non-INSTALLMENT plan; a wrong non-empty value fails
tbd: input bridge: interprose-to-lexicon@1.0.0 writes Neptune CSV while v4 reads Parquet graph exports; bind through a Transform tables/ Parquet output, a v4 input declaration that accepts the Neptune prefix, or an approved conversion step
created_at: Transform outputs do not carry the Persist-assigned created_at used first by the is_dsa election; the round trip must either carry it or record that only effective_at ordering was proven
run on the same UTC date as the sample snapshot, because the forward installment SQL filters future slots with current_date()
form_1281 baseline oracle derived directly from debt_settlement_agency in the same sample, restricted to DSA_NAME and DSA_REPRESENTATION

partialInputPolicy.mechanism: A contract-version-2 request may name outputDatasets; resolve-plan then requires only the requiredInputs of the selected outputs and rejects a missing one before Glue starts.
